market_brief: Risk assets ended a violent November week on a strong note: the S&P 500 rose 1.6% and the Nasdaq 100 2.6% in Friday's half-day session, capping a 5.6% weekly gain (best since April 2025), with semis leading (SOX +4.7%) and VIX easing to 23.8. The rebound came despite higher rates: the US 10Y rose about 9bp to 4.94% and the 30Y to 5.33% as a December 9 Fed hike is treated as near-certain, while DXY firmed to 104.0 and USD/JPY pushed toward 160. Metals squeezed higher (gold +3.8% to about $3,668, silver +9.1%, copper +5%), but oil eased into Sunday's OPEC+ 2027 quota meeting (WTI $83.08; front-month Brent reported at $95.44). Bitcoin (-1.2% to about $59,800) did not join the rally. For India, the weekend brings Q2 GDP (consensus ~7.6%) on November 30 ahead of a December 4 RBI decision where Nomura now calls for a 50bp hike, with the rupee near 93.
ai_brief: Deal and chip-control headlines led: Anthropic reportedly bought SDK-maker Stainless for over $300m and is shutting rivals' access, and Bloomberg found Nvidia GB300 hardware at a Shanghai site tied to Alice Huang as export scrutiny widens. Reuters reports US curbs could slow Chinese labs' release cadence, while Tencent open-sourced the DFly2 speculative decoder. OpenAI tightened GPT-6.2 usage limits after a pricing error, and Google's Cogentic agent posted six unverified math papers.

items.headline: Wall Street closes Black Friday half-day sharply higher; S&P 500 logs best week since April 2025
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 1.6% to 7,297, the Nasdaq 100 2.6% and the Dow 1.2%, leaving the S&P up 5.6% for the week after the prior week's near-9% slide. It is still on track for its worst November since 2008 with one session left.

items.headline: Chips lead: SOX +4.7% as Sandisk jumps 16% and Micron 7.6%, but Nvidia lags at +0.8%
items.summary: Memory and networking names drove the rebound (Sandisk +16%, Lumentum +8%, Micron +7.6%, Marvell +7.3%), while Nvidia closed only 0.8% higher at about $150.49 amid its governance overhang.

items.headline: Update: Anthropic shares surge 11% to about $91.88, back above the $83 IPO price
items.summary: After hovering near its IPO price earlier in the week, Anthropic stock closed about 11% higher on Friday. The next lockup expiry is due December 15.

items.headline: Tesla +5.2%, SpaceX +4.8% on report boards are discussing an all-stock combination
items.summary: The Financial Times reported that Tesla and SpaceX boards are discussing an all-stock deal, per Kiplinger's wrap; the companies have not confirmed terms. Tesla's annual meeting is on December 3.

items.headline: 10Y Treasury yield jumps ~9bp to 4.94% as a December 9 Fed hike is treated as near-certain
items.summary: Yields rose across the curve (30Y about 5.33%) after Wednesday's core PCE printed 3.3% versus 3.2% expected; futures traders have almost fully priced a 25bp hike at the December 8-9 FOMC.

items.headline: Flows: retail traders net sold ~$350m of single stocks on Monday, most since March 2020, per Vanda
items.summary: Vanda Research data cited by Yahoo Finance show retail investors sold into the start of the rebound (excluding Nvidia and Anthropic). Interactive Brokers' Steve Sosnick said it is too early to call the rally a dead-cat bounce.

items.headline: European shares post strong weekly gain led by chips and miners; Spanish election in focus
items.summary: The Stoxx 600 rose about 1.1% on Friday, with technology and mining stocks extending their rebound, as investors look ahead to Spain's general election.

items.headline: Update: Brent settles 1.2% lower at $95.44 but logs a weekly gain into Sunday's OPEC+ meeting
items.summary: Front-month Brent eased after Thursday's Middle East-driven spike, while WTI settled near $83.08, per reports. The dashboard's Brent series (different contract) shows $90.84.

items.headline: OPEC+ meets Sunday to set 2027 quotas, with its capacity audit running weeks late
items.summary: The group, which held December targets flat for a third month, will decide whether audited capacity becomes the basis for 2027 limits; Saudi Arabia reportedly favours tying quotas to the audit.

items.headline: Precious and base metals squeeze higher: gold +3.8%, silver +9.1%, copper up again
items.summary: Gold settled near $3,668 and silver near $43.70 on the dashboard after 52-week lows midweek, while copper futures added about 3% after Thursday's surge of as much as 6.5%.

items.headline: Nomura raises RBI call to a 50bp hike on December 4, sees CPI above 6% for two quarters
items.summary: Nomura now expects a half-point repo increase, more than the 25bp hike most economists in a Reuters poll anticipate for December. The rupee is near 93 per dollar on the dashboard.

items.headline: Update: Reuters poll of 43 economists sees Q2 GDP at 7.6%, above RBI's 7.2% projection
items.summary: Forecasts range from about 7.4% (Bank of Baroda) to 7.8% (SBI Research); a weak monsoon is the main drag on farm output. Data are due November 30.

items.headline: Taiwan lifts 2026 GDP growth forecast to 13.28% on the AI export boom
items.summary: The statistics agency raised its forecast from 11.05%, reflecting surging AI server and chip shipments.

items.headline: Update: foreign funds on pace for record NT$1.09tn (~$33bn) Taiwan stock exodus in November
items.summary: Bloomberg reports the outflow, larger than earlier tallies, came as the AI rout hit Taiwan's chip-heavy market (Taiwan Weighted -15% 1M on the dashboard).

items.headline: S&P puts Nvidia's AA rating on watch for a downgrade over governance and key-person risk
items.summary: The agency is considering a cut to AA- within 90 days following Jensen Huang's reinstatement; Moody's separately moved its outlook to stable from positive, per reports.

items.headline: USD/JPY near 160 as OCBC flags intervention risk; markets lean toward a December 18 BoJ hike
items.summary: OCBC's strategist warned intervention risk rises as the pair nears 160 (159.56 on the dashboard); Japan's October core CPI rose to 3.5%, supporting hike bets.

items.headline: Calendar: OPEC+ and Spain vote Nov 29; India GDP Nov 30; US ISM Dec 1; Tesla AGM Dec 3; RBI Dec 4; FOMC Dec 8-9
items.summary: Also ahead: Anthropic's lockup expiry on December 15 and the BoJ decision on December 18; Indian markets also watch monthly auto sales.

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly buys SDK-generation startup Stainless for over $300m, cutting off rivals
items.summary: Stainless generated API client libraries used by OpenAI and Google; its hosted services for them will reportedly be shut down after the deal.

items.headline: Nvidia GB300 rack turns up at Shanghai site linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: The report adds to export-control scrutiny after CBS said two California Nvidia partner firms are Chinese-owned; Nvidia has already paused server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.

items.headline: Reuters: chip curbs and distillation crackdown threaten Chinese model release cadence
items.summary: Moonshot reportedly expects gaps between flagship releases to stretch from about six months to over a year without overseas compute, and Z.ai is said to be behind schedule.

items.headline: OpenAI patches GPT-6.2 pricing error; Astra users now hit limits about 40% faster
items.summary: Sol limits tighten about 25%, while Business customers get free Fast Mode through the end of 2026, per The Decoder.

items.headline: Google's Cogentic agent posts six math papers in a day on Gemini 4, including a claimed fast factoring result
items.summary: The claims, including a subexponential factoring algorithm, have not yet been independently verified.

items.headline: Tencent open-sources DFly2 speculative decoder, claiming up to 81% faster DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash inference
items.summary: The 0.85B-parameter drafter reuses the KV cache; Tencent reports up to 4.2x speedups on Hy4 Flash agent tasks.

items.headline: Qwen-Audio-3.1 expands to 59 ASR, 65 TTS and 53 realtime languages
items.summary: Alibaba widened language coverage across its three voice APIs without changing prices.

items.headline: Moonshot launches Kimi for Science with up to $20K of API credits per research project
items.summary: Applications for the first cohort close December 8.

items.headline: Canada adds C$700m to its AI Compute Access Fund, favouring sovereign providers
items.summary: The fund rises to C$1bn and will cover up to 80% of compute costs bought from Canadian sovereign providers.

items.headline: AI shopping agents flood Black Friday: agent traffic to US retailers up about 150x, per Human Security
items.summary: Meta's agent reportedly accounts for about 70% of that traffic; retailers are also seeing AI-driven ransomware activity well above normal levels.

items.headline: Trending on GitHub: t3code, Claude-BugHunter and the ARTEX pen-testing framework
items.summary: Developer attention is on coding-agent front ends and security skill packs; ARTEX is the tool Microsoft says state hackers are using.

items.headline: FDA clears Neuralink's pivotal LINK brain-implant trial in ALS
items.summary: The clearance moves the brain-computer interface toward a registrational study.
